# tsuru_pool (Data Source)

Reads a tsuru pool, including the values allowed by its constraints.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tsuru_pool" "my-pool" {
  name = "my-pool"
}

output "my-pool-plans" {
  value = one([for c in data.tsuru_pool.my-pool.allowed : c.values if c.field == "plan"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Pool name

### Read-Only

- `allowed` (List of Object) Values allowed by the pool constraints, one entry per constraint field (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allowed))
- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default pool
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels of the pool
- `public` (Boolean) Whether the pool is available to every team
- `teams` (List of String) Teams allowed to use the pool
- `tsuru_provisioner` (String) Provisioner of pool

<a id="nestedatt--allowed"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allowed`

Read-Only:

- `field` (String)
- `values` (List of String)
